Script 1 · “The rollercoaster”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If you’re in sales, you know this cycle: great month, ease off, scramble, repeat.”

Body

“It’s not a skills problem. You already know how to sell. It’s what happens in your head after a good month, and the habits that quietly slip. Fix that, and the months start to look the same, in a good way.”

CTA

“I’m running a live 60-minute masterclass on exactly this. It’s $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera in your denim jacket, key line as on-screen text in mustard.

Script 2 · “Call reluctance”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“You know exactly which calls you should be making today. So why haven’t you?”

Body

“Call reluctance isn’t laziness. It’s your brain protecting you from a ‘no’. Once you see that, you can work with it, and the calls stop feeling so heavy.”

CTA

“In the Consistent Closer Masterclass I’ll show you the reset I teach my clients. 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, phone in hand, cut to a card with the question written out.

“Confidence drives consistency, and consistency drives cash flow. Get the first two right and the third has a chance. I’ve been coaching this since 2014.”
